label: belongs to index class
type: assigns an index type to one of the two classes indexes.md declares up front: Traditional or Vector.
note: PROMOTED BELOW THRESHOLD on significance, and deliberately NOT collapsed into isSubtypeOf even though both are hierarchical. Collapsing them would erase the finding: the class axis and the type axis OVERLAP rather than nest. A Composite Vector Index is stated to BE a GSI, so index-class:vector cuts across index-type:gsi; and a Search index is classed Traditional while a Search Vector index is classed Vector, so class cuts across the providing-service axis too. Two predicates preserve a real structural fact that one would flatten away.
relates_to_competency_question: Which class of index is this?
